may_access: the current stage control endpoint through calibration_002 commands
the current stage status projection and current-frame image files
the current stage blank or explicitly inherited Kevin Speak workspace
the exact approved learned-stack transfer prepared for this stage
generic ARC SDK action-interface documentation in this repository
must_not_access: official ls20 source code or internal game objects
prior calibration frames, traces, recordings, proposals, assessments, or action sequences
prior Scientist traces or derived gameplay hints
action_selector.reasoning_record: concise decision-relevant summaries only; no hidden chain of thought is requested or retained

completion.authoritative: the current official environment frame reports GameState.WIN
completion.game_over: failure evidence; use RESET only when offered and budget permits
completion.not_finished: continue while the current stage budget remains

kevin_speak.purpose: lossless working-language compression without changing the reasoning
kevin_speak.rule: only active translation-table tokens may be used as shorthand; everything else stays in the residual lane
kevin_speak.successor_rule: recommendations are advisory until separately reviewed and target-bound adoption is recorded

loop: inspect only the current projected frame and approved learned stack
submit one smallest useful proposal draft
submit one assessment draft that preserves or revises only implicated hypotheses
repeat until WIN or the stage boundary
